analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 109,300) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 103,470/102,299/118,546) — Below short/mid-term trends, above mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (KRW 110,806/89,189) — Mid-to-long-term trend at neutral level.
· 52-week position (61.0%) + Current price range historically in the middle.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.6→51.8) — Exiting oversold, confirmed recovery to neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (363.1729→1884.8354) — Improving, bullish expansion signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band KRW 102,299) — Sideways movement near the mid-band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 82,710) — Based on Pivot S1 (KRW 89,673).
· Swing resistance (KRW 126,140) — Breakout would strengthen uptrend.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — Confirmed recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.51x) — Low confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Buy entry conditions met, further upside expected.
